description.value: Tony's Place Restaurant is a casual diner in Abbotsford known for its loaded homemade 8oz beef burgers and all-day breakfast plates, with a wide menu spanning eggs benedict, fluffy omelettes, soups, and sandwiches. The restaurant occupies a strip-mall unit on Peardonville Road and offers online ordering with delivery service. Vegetarian options are available, including a veggie burger and vegetarian burrito.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms the restaurant name, address (Unit 101 - 31120 Peardonville Road), and phone number (604-850-9288), matching OSM tags. The menu pages confirm vegetarian options (Veggie Burger, Vegetarian Burrito) and an online ordering/delivery system, but no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities was found anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Tony's Place is a legitimate, active restaurant useful to touring cyclists, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify minimum WWC criteria before listing.
